fixture: Public seed permutes cases and slots 1..4. Raw value for slot s, channel c, local time t is (4*s+c%16-8+(t+seed%7)%7)/32. Histories use t=-3,-2,-1. Weight tap j is ((c+j+seed%5)%5-2)/8. Null slot and projected 320-channel tail are 3.25. Decode always uses history; prefill request indices 0 and 2 use history, others start fresh.
reference: For each request independently, prepend its three old raw inputs or three zero rows. Sum four FP32 dyadic products in oldest-to-newest tap order, apply SiLU, compare every output. Final state equals last three raw input rows, byte-exact in SD backing. Unselected and null state slots remain byte-exact. Prefill must preserve all projected input bytes; decode must alias its projected input and preserve the 320-channel tail.
staging_scope: Persistent pinned probe input, weight, state, IDs, starts, initial flags and readback buffers. Actual upstream metadata helper's pinned host arrays are verified and retained through synchronization. This is a bounded measurement, not a claim of persistent metadata reuse throughout production.
